description: This source file defines data structures and functions to load and parse gateway configuration data from a JSON file. It includes structs 'GatewayConfig' and 'GatewayEndpoint', and functions 'loadGatewayConfig' and 'parseInt', handling file reading, JSON deserialization, and configuration mapping.

methods.name: loadGatewayConfig
methods.description: Loads the gateway configuration from a JSON file located in the user's home directory, deserializes the JSON data, and maps it into a 'GatewayConfig' instance.

methods.name: parseInt
methods.description: Attempts to convert a given value of type 'Any?' into an 'Int?', handling different potential formats such as numbers and strings.
